verdict.rationale: The evidence shows integrations that run the other way: Devin's MCP server exposes Devin to other agents, and the Devin Handoff plugin brings Devin's handoff workflow into Claude Code, Codex and Cursor. Nothing shows a way to plug third-party, partner-built agent apps into Devin-driven workflows. The Slack, Teams, Linear and Jira integrations are adjacent tool connections, not partner agent apps.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can integrate third-party partner-built agent apps into my workflows
